data.define: Used to show surprise or disbelief.

misuse.text: Don't say 'no way' when someone asks for help.
misuse.why: It sounds like a harsh refusal.

publish.title: What does "no way" mean?
publish.value: No way = I can't believe it. Example: "No way! You got tickets?" (casual English).
